---
title: "kqucomp"
---

## Description

Compare datasets.

## Parameters

**`base`**

: Name of the dataset which is used as base in compare procedure

  *Required:* Yes

**`qc`**

: Prefix of the qc dataset name

  *Required:* No

**`id`**

: List of id variables

  *Required:* No

**`prod_lib`**

: Name of the library from which base dataset is uploaded

  *Required:* Yes

**`qc_lib`**

: Name of the library from which qc dataset is uploaded

  *Required:* Yes

**`crit`**

: Criterion for the compare procedure, if needed

  *Required:* No

**`supp`**

: Flag that determines whether to compare SUPP dataset or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

**`com`**

: Flag that determines whether to compare comments dataset or not

  *Required:* No

  *Default:* `N`

## Examples

```sas
%kqucomp(base=DM,prod_lib=sdtm,supp=Y,com=Y);
```
